notes: Roman Wide Field Instrument, detector SCA03 only: the owner's per-SCA effective areas (Roman_effarea_v8_SCA03_20240301.ecsv, parameters as of 2024-03-01; CC0, https://github.com/RomanSpaceTelescope/roman-technical-information at 14a9b0c). Transmission = effective area in m^2 divided by 4.374354 m^2 = pi*(2.36 m/2)^2 aperture-stop area (owner MissionandObservatory.yaml); central obscuration not removed. Grism = Grism_1stOrder column; Grism_0thOrder is the zeroth-order image. Leading/trailing zero samples trimmed to one bounding zero. DetectorType photon from the owner's count-rate zero-point definition; components inferred (effective area = whole system). The detector-averaged set is Roman/WFI.
